title: Dispatch: bootstrap ledger review corrections from PR #477 (attempt 3)
description:
HUMAN REVIEW OF PR #477 at head 8fd61cf returned "request changes": three P1,
four P2 and one remaining P3. All are accepted. Read the review on
https://github.com/jbongaarts/eshyra/pull/477 for the reviewer's exact wording.
Both CI workflows pass — these are contract defects CI cannot catch.

=== FILES YOU OWN ===
  docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/bootstrap-capability-ledger.json
  docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/bootstrap-capability-ledger.md
  docs/audits/dnd5e-srd-5.1-final/2n1t-engine-closure-reconciliation.md
  packages/core/src/rules/bootstrapCapabilityLedger.ts
  packages/core/test/bootstrapCapabilityLedger.test.ts

=== P1-A: THE VALIDATOR CAN NO LONGER REPRESENT proposed-new-bead ===
*** THIS IS THE SUPERVISOR'S REGRESSION, INTRODUCED IN COMMIT 8fd61cf. ***
The schema requires every row to have an owningBead. The new invariant then
UNCONDITIONALLY rejects 'eshyra-olc5' as owningBead — including when
ownershipStatus is 'proposed-new-bead'. The failure message advises using
ownershipStatus=proposed-new-bead, which does not bypass the rejection. There is
now no honest value for owningBead when no bead and no exact family owner
exists: a caller must invent a nonexistent bead ID or falsely assign a family
epic. That contradicts the documented workflow, which says future unowned
primitives are recorded as proposed in the same manner.

Fix: make owningBead optional/null for proposed rows, OR permit the engine epic
root ONLY when ownershipStatus === 'proposed-new-bead'. Then add a POSITIVE test
that constructs a proposed row and validates it successfully — the existing
proposed-row loop is vacuous because the checked-in ledger now contains none.
Keep the real invariant intact: an 'owned' row may never name the engine epic
root.

=== P1-B: THE RECONCILIATION STILL REACHES THE WRONG CONCLUSION ===
See the CORRECTION note on the parent bead eshyra-o9bd.19.5.1 — read it first;
it is authoritative over the parent description's four-category list.

The document concludes zero premature closures and classifies eshyra-2n1t itself
as only a taxonomy mismatch. But the PR that closed it was titled "Complete SRD
audit and engine gaps", claimed source-grounded executable mechanics for ALL 240
magic items, reported zero deep-audit findings, and named eshyra-2n1t and
eshyra-o9bd.18 as its beads.

Narrow child beads may still be correctly closed — their primitives landed. The
umbrella completeness claim is a different object. Distinguish explicitly:
  * narrow child acceptance genuinely completed;
  * broader integration not completed;
  * umbrella epic closed on a global claim later proven false.
Classify eshyra-2n1t as premature / overstated umbrella closure, or add an
equivalent explicit category and define it. Rewrite the "Why no category is
PREMATURE CLOSURE" section accordingly — do not leave a heading that contradicts
the table.

Also reconsider eshyra-o9bd.18.7: source clauses omitted or silently partially
projected are IMPORTER/COMPILER completeness defects, not merely downstream
engine work. Its current DIFFERENT SCOPE OR TAXONOMY classification rests on
that mischaracterization.

Still do not reopen, close, or modify any bead. Record recommendations as data.

=== P1-C: packEvidence IS PROSE, NOT AN EXECUTABLE QUERY ===
This is the deepest finding. The docs say membership is represented by generated
queries and tell consumers to execute them. In reality packEvidence is a
free-form string; validation only checks non-emptiness and the test only greps
for the substrings 'record.key' and 'data.executionReadiness'. There is no query
identifier, evaluator, predicate, generated record-key membership, or
source-comparison function.

Consequences: membership cannot be regenerated; two ledger versions cannot be
mechanically diffed; invalid or copy-pasted query prose stays green; and
eshyra-o9bd.19.5.12 cannot reliably reconcile the authoritative ledger against
this bootstrap one — which is that bead's entire purpose.

Fix: give rows STABLE QUERY IDS backed by executable functions, or a structured
query representation with a tested evaluator. Execute against the committed pack
at packages/core/data/rules-packs/rules__dnd5e-srd-5.1/records.json. Rows whose
evidence is a negative or source-comparison claim need a REPRODUCIBLE SECOND
INPUT, not prose saying to compare against "the audit" — if the second input
cannot yet be expressed, say so explicitly on the row with a defined follow-up
rather than leaving prose that reads as executable.

Note the sibling work: eshyra-o9bd.19.1.6 (PR #476) is concurrently adding
stable membership identities {recordKey, clauseId/path, sourceSpan} to the
finding registry. Use a compatible identity shape so 19.5.12 can join them
later. Do not edit that file — it is on another branch.

=== P2-D: THE engine:F1 ROW QUERIES engine:F2 ===
Row capabilityId engine:F1, primitive 'seeded-selection-and-roll-replacement',
but its packEvidence selects hooks qualified as engine:F2 with activation /
action-economy semantics. That is unrelated evidence copied from the F2 family.
It should query F1 selection, table/pool/percentage, or roll-replacement hooks.
The executable query contract from P1-C must also ENFORCE that a row cannot
silently target another family.

=== P2-E: THE SEVEN-ROW NON-PACK PROOF IS NOT ASSERTED ===
The PR body claimed 7 of 31 rows are non-pack discoveries with a test asserting
it. The test only requires more than two rows plus the presence of the legendary
and point-origin primitives; the validator requires only three. The docs also
list retained-asset creation as a non-pack discovery, but that row includes
'readiness-artifacts' in discoveredBy, so by the ledger's own definition it is
not in the non-pack set.

Fix: pin the exact non-pack primitive IDs explicitly and assert that set. This
set is the evidence that the five-source method escaped the pack's blind spots,
so it must be exact and the prose must match the data.

=== P2-F: CORRECTIVE OWNERSHIP OMITS TWO OF FOUR OVERLAPS ===
The corrective section routes only eshyra-2n1t.7 and .12 to the new beads, but
the table itself establishes two more:
  * .6 includes spell copying among its missing engine:F4 procedures ->
    eshyra-o9bd.19.5.5.3
  * .9 includes planar-return clocks among its missing engine:F7 procedures ->
    eshyra-o9bd.19.5.8.3
Route .6, .7, .9 and .12.

=== P2-G: STORED-COUNT REJECTION IS NOT MEANINGFULLY TESTED ===
The validator rejects only four exact top-level keys: count, counts,
recordCount, clauseCount. Nested counts and names like total, storedCount or
hookTotal pass. Worse, the test mutates capabilityId AND count together, and
capability validation runs first — so the test can pass without ever exercising
count rejection.

Fix: split into separate tests, and either use a strict schema or recursively
reject count/total-shaped fields at any depth.

=== P3-H: THE VALIDATOR DOES NOT ENFORCE THE ADVERTISED SHAPE ===
The PR claims 31 rows and 2-4 per family; the validator enforces only >=2 per
family. It does not enforce a total, an upper bound per family, unique
primitives, or unique family/primitive pairs. Primitive uniqueness is checked
only against the current static file, not by the exported validator.
Enforce uniqueness of primitives and of family/primitive pairs in the validator.
Use judgement on hard totals — a fixed row count is itself a hand-copied number
and should NOT be asserted; an upper bound per family is also arbitrary. Prefer
enforcing the structural invariants and correcting the prose instead.

=== COUNT HYGIENE, CLARIFIED ===
A GENERATED, regenerable snapshot of member identities is NOT a hand-copied
count and is exactly the right instrument here. What is forbidden is a human
transcribing a total (391, 399, 77, 79, 794) into an assertion. Do not let the
count-hygiene rule block P1-C or P2-E.

=== ENVIRONMENT AND VERIFICATION ===
Run `npm ci` FIRST. Run `npm run verify:worktree` BEFORE committing — it
rewrites files.

=== HARD CONSTRAINTS ===
* Edit ONLY the files listed above. Do not touch package.json,
  packages/core/package.json, or packages/core/src/internal.ts.
* Do NOT modify any bead except your own. Do NOT run `bd dolt push`.
* Do NOT push, do NOT open or comment on a PR, do NOT merge.
* Where a committed test encodes defective behavior, change it deliberately and
  record why. Do not delete a test to make a finding disappear.
* Do NOT regenerate the rules pack and do NOT run the SRD importer.
acceptance_criteria:
• A proposed-new-bead row is representable and validates, proven by a positive test; an owned row still may not name the engine epic root.
• eshyra-2n1t is classified as premature/overstated umbrella closure or an equivalent defined category, with narrow-child acceptance distinguished from the umbrella claim; the contradicting section heading is rewritten.
• eshyra-o9bd.18.7 reconsidered on importer/compiler completeness grounds.
• Every row carries a stable query ID backed by an executable function or a structured query with a tested evaluator; negative/source-comparison rows have a reproducible second input or an explicit stated gap.
• A row cannot silently target another capability family, enforced by the query contract; the engine:F1 row queries F1 hooks.
• The exact non-pack primitive set is pinned and asserted, and the prose matches the data.
• Corrective ownership routes .6, .7, .9 and .12.
• Count rejection is tested independently and catches nested/alternative count names.
• Primitive and family/primitive uniqueness are enforced by the exported validator.
• npm run verify:worktree passes.
notes: Completion report (review correction): fixed all accepted P1/P2/P3 findings. P1-A was a supervisor regression in 8fd61cf, not a defect introduced by this correction; proposed-new-bead rows now allow owningBead null/optional while owned rows still reject eshyra-olc5. packEvidence is now a registered structured query with stable queryId, family enforcement, executable evaluation against records.json, and recordKey/clauseId/path/sourceSpan identities. Source-negative rows explicitly record second-input-unavailable plus a follow-up. Corrected F1 seeded-selection evidence, pinned and validated the exact seven-row non-pack set, recursively rejected count/total-shaped fields, split the defective combined capability/count test, and enforced primitive and family/primitive uniqueness without hand-copied totals. Reconciliation now distinguishes narrow child acceptance from premature/overstated eshyra-2n1t umbrella closure, classifies eshyra-o9bd.18.7 as premature importer/compiler projection closure, and routes .6/.7/.9/.12 to .19.5.5.3/.6.3/.8.3/.11.3. The committed tests that asserted only more than two non-pack rows and combined capability/count mutation were deliberately changed because they encoded the defective behavior identified by review. I disagree with none of the accepted findings. Focused ledger tests: 8 passed. Final npm run verify:worktree: 263 test files passed, 4 skipped; 4717 tests passed, 19 skipped. Follow-ups: eshyra-myg3 and eshyra-gull. No PR comment, push, merge, parent-bead modification, or bd dolt push performed.
